name: QinetiQ Group plc
summary: QinetiQ Group plc provides science and technology solution in the defense, security, and infrastructure markets in the United States, Australia, Canada, and Germany. The company operates through four segments: Test and Training; Mission Support and Operations; Research and Development; and Engineering Services. It offers test and evaluation, training and simulation, mission rehearsal, and threat representation; cyber and intelligence capabilities, mission data, and persistent surveillance.
